scope: CSS @font-face loading on the Godot host: the core lists rules (ABI minor 25), the host loads sources and registers families. Windows only; candidate not installed. Extended with real bold/italic files as backend variants and register_font_face.

core.note: test_c_abi covers parsing, quoting, local() skipping, base-path resolution, duplicate suppression, media gating and buffer protocol; core unchanged since the gamepad receipt, whose 14/14 and 16/16 sanitizer runs cover this library

findings: @font-face url() sources load and register through the same asset convention as images, on the patched and the stock editor.

Bold (600-799), black (800+) and italic rules are adopted as real faces; the backend variant hook answers with the exact file, the other bold strength, or one axis synthesized over the other file, before falling back to synthesis.
register_font_face supplies the same files from a script; a null font removes one.
The diagnostics fixture uses @page as its unsupported rule; @font-face is no longer reported.
limitations: unicode-range, font-display and local() are not honoured; weight ranges keep their first number.
